segments.caption: A person walks past the Saigon Sandwich shop on a city street, where a menu board lists Vietnamese sandwiches and a framed award for “Best Bay Area Winner 2016” is displayed. The camera then shows the sandwich shop’s window display and finally focuses on a freshly made banh mi sandwich being held in paper, revealing its colorful fillings of meat, carrots, and herbs.
A person holds and takes a bite of a fresh, vegetable-filled sandwich while standing on a paved sidewalk, with pigeons foraging nearby and city traffic in the background.
A person eats a fresh Vietnamese sandwich while standing on a city sidewalk, as a flock of pigeons forages nearby on the pavement.
A person eats a fresh banh mi sandwich while standing on a paved surface, with a group of pigeons nearby; one pigeon is shown in close-up, appearing to watch or approach the person.
A person holds a cup of sweet, layered dessert while a corgi sniffs the ground nearby, and a pigeon stands on the pavement, capturing a casual, everyday moment outdoors.
A person holds and begins to eat a cup of sweet, milky dessert with beans and tapioca pearls, then transitions to unwrapping and eating a separate, wrapped food item while seated on the ground.
A person sits outdoors, carefully unwrapping a steamed fish from its leaf and plastic packaging, then uses a plastic fork to lift and eat a piece of the white, flaky fish.

A person enjoys a sandwich from Saigon Sandwiches in San Francisco, with a close-up of the food and a brief shot of the surrounding street scene before the video ends with a thank you message to the restaurant.
